hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: The scandal surrounding Argentina's Cabinet Chief Manuel Adorni has intensified, with opposition parties pushing for his interpellation in the Senate. The government has repeatedly blocked these attempts, leading to parliamentary deadlock and internal fractures within the ruling coalition.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high moral charge and polarized contention over corruption allegations, threatening the credibility of President Milei's administration.

hotspots.title: Meloni-Macron alliance strengthens
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and French President Emmanuel Macron held a high-profile bilateral summit in Antibes, signing multiple agreements on defense, energy, and space cooperation. The summit marks a thaw in previously strained relations between the two leaders.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the geopolitical stakes, the symbolic significance of Franco-Italian cooperation, and the contrast with Meloni's strained relations with Trump.
